title: Deliver Iron Ore to Penfingborough Steel Mill
briefing:
You run a young transport company. A customer needs **Iron Ore** delivered to **Penfingborough Steel Mill** (industry id 10, near tile 29,79).

A likely supplier is **Gindingworth Iron Ore Mine** (industry id 9, near tile 36,43); any source counts, only what your company delivers to that industry is counted.

If you conclude the contract cannot be met by anyone, say so with `rh abstain reason="..."`; abstaining on a feasible contract scores zero.
